title: TextEffectFailureReason
description: Why a text node cannot draw a requested outline or shadow. - `'no-distance-field'`: color glyphs (`Text` with `colorGlyphs`) or a plain bitmap font (`BitmapText` without `msdf`) render RGBA glyphs and have no distance to measure an effect against. - `'unknown-range'`: an MSDF font that does not declare its distance range, zero value and glyph padding. - `'invalid-range'`: an MSDF font whose declared range, zero value or padding cannot encode any outward distance. - `'insufficient-effect-capacity'`: the effect is larger than the distance field and the glyph quads reach.

sections.title: Import
paragraphs: Why a text node cannot draw a requested outline or shadow.

- `'no-distance-field'`: color glyphs (`Text` with `colorGlyphs`) or a plain bitmap font (`BitmapText` without `msdf`) render RGBA glyphs and have no distance to measure an effect against. - `'unknown-range'`: an MSDF font that does not declare its distance range, zero value and glyph padding. - `'invalid-range'`: an MSDF font whose declared range, zero value or padding cannot encode any outward distance. - `'insufficient-effect-capacity'`: the effect is larger than the distance field and the glyph quads reach.
